levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Three «ح»-joined branches (rule 3): Ibn Numayr through his father, Abu Bakr through Abu Usama, and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna through Abd al-Wahhab
The first two meet at «قالا حدثنا عبيد الله»; the shared tail is the line after the last «ح»: عبيد الله، نافع، ابن عمر
The gloss «- واللفظ له -» and «- يعني الثقفي -» are left out
